title: 1992 AMC 8 Problem 5
statement: A circle of diameter \(1\) is removed from a \(2 \times 3\) rectangle, as shown. Which whole number is closest to the area of the shaded region?

solutions.text:
The rectangle has area \(6,\) and the removed circle has area \(\pi\left(\dfrac12\right)^2 = \dfrac{\pi}{4} \approx 0.79.\)

So the shaded region has area \(6 - 0.79 \approx 5.2,\) whose closest whole number is \(5.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: The rectangle has area \(2 \times 3 = 6\); subtract the area of the circle
The circle has radius \(\dfrac12,\) so its area is \(\pi\left(\dfrac12\right)^2 = \dfrac{\pi}{4},\) a little less than \(1\)
